item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Stage uploads durably before importing.","mechanism":"Resumable disk or object storage decouples connection lifetime from processing without buffering the file in memory.","implementation":"Persist upload offsets; stream and verify the supplied digest before processing. Enforce storage quotas, backpressure, and a total memory budget below 128 MB.","check":"Disconnect halfway through 4 GB; resume uploading, verify the digest, and measure peak memory under slow database writes.","risk":"Finite staging capacity requires explicit refusal and expiry policies."},{"action":"Commit accepted rows with their replay ledger.","mechanism":"Atomic batch writes couple database changes to durable row outcomes, preventing crash-induced duplicate application.","implementation":"Use bounded batches; uniquely identify outcomes by import scope, digest, and source line. Commit writes, outcomes, and checkpoint together; explicitly reject conflicting natural keys.","check":"Crash before and after batch commits, then restart. Confirm accepted rows appear once and checkpoints never skip uncommitted outcomes.","risk":"Concurrent imports require database-enforced uniqueness and a documented natural-key conflict policy."},{"action":"Quarantine bad rows with exact correction details.","mechanism":"Explicit rejection outcomes isolate invalid references without substituting plausible values or aborting unrelated rows.","implementation":"Validate references without coercion; isolate database failures using savepoints or batch bisection. Store line, natural key, field, reason, and staged-record locator; cap parser buffers.","check":"Inject invalid references and an oversized record; confirm valid neighbors commit and each rejected record is locatable without truncation.","risk":"Malformed CSV may prevent safe boundary recovery; stop with an explicit incomplete status."},{"action":"Publish a reconciled partial-result manifest.","mechanism":"A durable accounting manifest distinguishes completed partial imports from interrupted processing and links subsequent corrections.","implementation":"Record digest verification, EOF status, accepted, rejected, and pending counts. Require one outcome per parsed record; link corrected-file outcomes to original rejections.","check":"At EOF, verify accepted plus rejected equals parsed records, pending is zero, and accepted ledger entries match committed writes.","risk":"Counts alone miss substitutions; reconcile row identities and committed versions, not totals alone."}],"abstention_reason":""}
